Generation has an explicit coordinate and work domain; on-demand proposal generation and the bounded preview cache do not implement resident-world loading, eviction or modified-world persistence.

questions.query: Can a completed procedural chunk from an old recipe or a previous World reset overwrite player edits or a reserved empty chunk?

World install_generated_chunk accepts a material span only for an absent destination under exclusive ownership between ticks, and refuses every resident chunk including empty reservations and edited-then-cleared chunks.

The material-only World method does not know generator identity or World/reset-session identity. A caller must establish both, and the current workbench only previews copied chunks without installing into the sandbox World.

questions.query: How can advanced architectural modules extend chunk generation, and what does the engine actually enforce about module cost, dependencies, failure and mutable World access?
facts: Versioned registry factories prepare immutable feature samplers off the simulation tick; explicit instance dependencies receive deterministic topological ordering and modules sample only inside declared bounds.

A module receives coordinate, effective parameters/palette and previous proposed material, returns at most one material, and cannot reach mutable World through the supplied context. Invalid output or callback failure discards the complete pending proposal.
Declared logical work and output capacities are enforced, but in-process C++ samplers remain trusted cooperative code. Recipes select registered modules and do not load arbitrary executable plugins.

questions.query: Does a Hilbert or Morton generation field make one continuous infinite corridor, and do its tiles change at negative chunk boundaries?
facts: Hilbert guarantees edge adjacency between consecutive ranks inside a finite power-of-two tile only; repeated tiles do not promise a continuous infinite Hilbert curve. Morton interleaves coordinates and successive ranks need not share an edge.
Orders 1 through 20 and integer cell sizes 1 through 4096 use signed floor tiling at absolute coordinates, independently of the output chunk partition.
The separately defined macrocell hub/port network owns interconnected procedural routes. Curve fields can guide masks, parameters or material variation without replacing that network.

questions.query: Can a sidechained mask inspect material painted by an earlier sculpting modifier, or can a masked theme blend restore a globally excluded theme?
facts: The field DAG evaluates each declared node once at a sample from immutable initial proposal context, after original theme/brush/hard geometry but before fields, modules, material modifiers, connecting routes, paths and hard material.

Application times one-minus-exclusion times strength, context predicate and shape is captured once per modifier and reused for guidance and material output. Earlier modifiers cannot feed back into later context masks.

Missing references and cycles, including warp references, reject; warp shifts only the receiving primitive rather than recursively resampling dependencies. Global exclusions stay authoritative, hard geometry is reapplied after guidance, and hard material is final.

questions.query: Do procedural aggregate definitions create new mixture physics, and does grain_size quantize a named variation field?
facts: An aggregate realizes one existing material ID per cell, with 1 through 16 unique components and strictly positive finite weights. It does not add density, reactions, fractional material state or simulation field storage.
Without a variation field, a seed-and-ID hash selects one material per signed world-aligned grain. A named variation field selects directly at each sample; grain_size does not quantize it.

Canonical recipes retain authored weights separately from prepared normalized selection. Zero, invalid IDs, duplicate components and normalization underflow reject; weights express preferences rather than finite-crop quotas.

questions.query: Does hiding a generator modifier or selecting a diagnostic bypass budgets, and can an old inspection packet enter a new preview or live World?
facts: The field graph caps 64 declarations, depth 16 and 4096 logical operations per sample. All declared field/modifier/component/module work counts even when masked; zero module influence avoids its callback but not its declared charge.

A field, modifier or module diagnostic is collected as normalized floats during paced cell generation. Its channel, shape and float bits join the receipt; altered data reject, and failure or cancellation discards both materials and diagnostics.

The workbench validates recipe identity, expected coordinate, inspection token, channel and values before caching copied proposals. It has no live World installer; native admission still requires current recipe acceptance and caller-owned World/reset lifetime.
